correctness.rationale: For every k>=2, L>=1 and real 0<p<1, the tree has N=k+L+1 vertices. Uniform seed among N-1 survivors makes expected final component size the ordered-pair path-connectivity score S_v/(N-1). Removing hub gives k+H_L; removing v_t gives k+H_t+H_{L-t}+2k sum_{j<=t}p^j+k(k-1)p^2. The exact identity D_t=2p(1-p^t)(p^{L-t}-1+k(1-p))/(1-p)^2+k(k-1)p^2 and adjacent difference 2p/(1-p)[p^{L-t-1}-(1-k(1-p))p^t] were independently checked for 1056 rational (k,L,t,p) combinations. For t<=L/2, polynomial coefficients of D_t have at most one sign change, so Descartes plus D_t>0 near zero guarantees at most one interior root, and it is from hub-better to path-better. At p=1, D_t(1)=k(k-1)+2t(t+k-L), whose strict minimum yields switch iff d=L-k>=2 and 2 floor(d^2/4)>k(k-1). Leaf deletion is strictly dominated by deletion of its neighbor for positive p, covering all vertices and boundaries. For p>1-1/k the adjacent-difference sign change yields the stated discrete path optimum. Lengthening L strictly decreases D_t for every fixed admissible path site, giving strictly decreasing thresholds once they exist. The positive correction to D_infinity tends to zero for t=floor(L/2); the bracket k(k-1)p(1-p)^2-2[1-k(1-p)] has one zero by monotonicity in u=1-p on (0,1/k), yielding the stated limit. The known k=2,L=5 threshold is p^2+p^3=1; all algebraic and domain checks agree.
residual_risks: The infinite quantifiers rely on analytic sign-variation and limiting arguments, not the 1056 finite exact tests. The model is independent bond-transmission final size, not general correlated edge or arbitrary SIR timing.

evidence: Holme exactly enumerates connected 3–7 vertex graphs; smallest switching broom in this model has 8 vertices. Hall–Siebert proves exact node-probability dynamics for Markovian SIR/SEIR on trees with a single initial source, not an optimal-vaccination location threshold on brooms of all sizes.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The prior stronger-seeming exact-tree model solves forward state probabilities, but no inspected theorem dominates the one-way optimizer transition for a deleted vertex across every k,L,p. A general algorithm for epidemic expectations is not an already evaluated sharp broom classification.
